description: Let \(M\) be a singleton where a unary predicate \(P\) is false, and \(N\) a singleton where \(P\) is true. Interpreting the added name by the unique point of \(N\) satisfies the positive diagram of \(M\), and its canonical map is injective, but that map is not an embedding because it does not reflect \(P\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.DiagramsAndExtensions.positive_predicate_diagram_does_not_reflect.{u_1} :
  let N := ULift.{u_1, 0} Unit;
  N ⊨
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.positiveDiagram Lemmatheca.Entry.DiagramsAndExtensions.predicateLanguage
        Unit ∧
    Function.Injective
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.canonicalMap Lemmatheca.Entry.DiagramsAndExtensions.predicateLanguage
          Unit N) ∧
      ¬∃ e,
          ⇑e =
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.canonicalMap Lemmatheca.Entry.DiagramsAndExtensions.predicateLanguage
              Unit N
